name: Search Places
description: Searches for attractions, restaurants, accommodations, and points of interest in a destination city or region.

location.description: The destination city, region, or country (e.g. 'Tokyo', 'Kyoto', 'Paris', 'Rome', 'New York')

query.description: Specific place name, activity, or cuisine (e.g. 'ramen', 'art museum', 'boutique hotel', 'gardens')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)
